class.name: TwovoipOpusEncoder
class.brief_description: Prepares and encodes microphone chunks as Opus packets.
class.description: Resamples mono or stereo input, optionally applies automatic gain, applies manual gain, measures the normalized signal for VOX, optionally denoises it, and encodes it with Opus.

method.name: create_opus_encoder
method.description: Creates the Opus encoder with the configured rate and channels. Returns [code]false[/code] and leaves no encoder active if any Opus option is rejected.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Initializes the immutable audio-processing pipeline. The Opus sample rate must be 8, 12, 16, 24 or 48 kHz, and the output chunk must represent 2.5, 5, 10, 20, 40 or 60 ms. It may succeed only once; a failed initialization leaves the object uninitialized and may be retried.

method.name: encode_chunk
method.description: Encodes a conditioned chunk, prepending optional bytes. A positive [param chunk_offset_back] selects an earlier buffered chunk for voice-activation rewind. Returns an empty array if encoding fails.

method.name: get_gain
method.description: Returns the linear gain currently applied during processing.

method.name: get_agc_gain
method.description: Returns the latest linear gain reported by the pre-denoising Speex AGC stage.

method.name: get_current_chunk_16khz
method.description: Experimental. Lazily converts the current conditioned chunk to mono 16 kHz PCM. Pass true after any skipped source chunks to discard resampler history. The caller must invoke this at most once for each processed chunk.

method.name: get_current_chunk
method.description: Returns the last processed output-rate PCM chunk as stereo frames, before Opus encoding.

method.name: get_peak
method.description: Returns the peak magnitude after automatic and manual gain but before denoising, for use by VOX.

method.name: get_required_input_chunk_size
method.description: Returns the minimum safe input allocation for each processing call.

method.name: get_rms
method.description: Returns the RMS level per sample after automatic and manual gain but before denoising, for use by VOX.

method.name: get_speech_probability
method.description: Returns the active denoiser's speech score normalized to 0–1 for the last chunk.

method.name: process_chunk
method.description: Processes one chunk and returns the number of input frames consumed, or a negative error.

method.name: reset_opus_encoder
method.description: Resets Opus state before beginning an unrelated stream.

method.name: set_gain
method.description: Sets the manual linear gain applied after automatic gain and before denoising.
